perplexity.description:
Underwater by Elephant Gym, originally released in 2018, is the Taiwanese instrumental rock trio’s second full-length album and a defining work in their discography. The album is characterized by its intricate, bass-driven compositions that blend elements of math rock, jazz, and funk, creating a fluid and dynamic soundscape. The music often evokes the sensation of movement and immersion, with melodies and rhythms that flow seamlessly into one another, mirroring the album’s aquatic theme. Elephant Gym’s signature use of complex time signatures and melodic interplay between guitar, bass, and drums is on full display, showcasing their technical prowess and compositional maturity.

Released on Topshelf Records, Underwater marked a significant step forward for the band, building on the promise of their debut and earning wider international recognition. The album was praised for its emotional depth and innovative approach to instrumental rock, with critics highlighting its ability to convey a sense of mystery and introspection without relying on lyrics. While not a mainstream commercial breakthrough, Underwater solidified Elephant Gym’s reputation as one of the most distinctive voices in contemporary math rock and helped expand the global reach of Taiwan’s independent music scene.
